5 تلدّد (tropical:) He turned his face to the right and left, (S, L, K,) in confusion, perplexity, or amazement: (L, K:) from اللَّدِيدَانِ signifying “ the two sides ” of the neck. (S, L.) ―
-b2- He tarried, or waited, in expectation. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
